content: DuckDB 1.3+ is the clear winner for algorithmic trading data at solo-project scale. SQLite lacks columnar compression and is slow on time-series range scans. PostgreSQL adds ops overhead (server, pg_hba.conf) unjustified for a one-machine project. DuckDB is in-process, zero-ops, columnar, SQL-complete, and scales to hundreds of millions of rows. Backup is a file copy.
